physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: The available evidence is context/baseline.json and context/protocol.json; reports/ contains no evaluation history. The only observed tuple is (40, 0.55, 0, 0), so (40, 0.55, 1, 0) is previously untried and within the frozen domain. The baseline is physical- and measurement-qualified, with cell area 161954 um2, setup slack 0.19292 ns, hold slack 0.114491 ns, zero reported electrical violations, and score 1.0. Its DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energies are 2.293945631906608e-7/1.7792685987008622e-6/1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Enable ABC area optimization as a single-variable attempt to reduce the cell-area factor of the specified area-times-geometric-mean-energy score. Retain baseline utilization and density to limit simultaneous placement changes, and retain repair_margin=0 because the baseline already qualifies and provides no evidence that additional repair margin is needed. Reducing die area alone does not directly improve the cell-area-based score. The narrow positive setup slack makes timing loss a material risk. No candidate area, energy, qualification, or score improvement is claimed before independent evaluation; energy remains limited to the baseline report model scope. RTL, period 10526 ps, libraries, and acceptance thresholds remain frozen.
